CustomField.description: End date of the store-to-route assignment validity period. If blank, the assignment is open-ended with no expiry. Together with Valid from Date, defines the active window for overlap checks.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date this routing assignment expires. Leave blank for an open-ended assignment with no end date. Overlapping date ranges for the same store and route are blocked. Must be on or after the Valid from Date.
CustomField.label: Valid to Date
